verdict.rationale: Phaser ships an official commercial Editor product (phaser.io/editor) with a drag-and-drop viewport, an Inspector view for animations/physics/filters, and scene composition tools (layers, particle emitters, object renaming), which aligns with the visual-editor story. However, it's a separate paid add-on rather than Phaser core's built-in workflow, there's no explicit mention of a prefab system, and no independent/hands-on evidence corroborates it being the 'primary' way artists build levels versus code-first scene authoring described throughout the core docs. missing for 10: independent corroboration of the Editor's viewport/inspector workflow, explicit prefab support, evidence it replaces code as primary workflow rather than supplementing it.
